redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-production tests only.
Public official pages, manuals and exact register receipts retained for validation; public access does not itself establish AGID redistribution or public-serving rights.
An exact Kartverket distribution explicitly licensed CC BY 4.0 with attribution, source URL, capture and release/reference time, changes, schema, CRS, coverage and digest pinned.
Permissioned, authenticated, purchased or unclear-rights material is used and redistributed only as specifically authorized.
Personal, ownership, title/value, shipment or non-redistributable evidence may detect discrepancies but cannot become public output.

sources.production_scope: Pinned complete current register receipt filtered only after full-file validation to municipality-code prefixes 21 and 22, retaining four-digit text, postal place, municipality code/name, category, effective time, source URL, terms, schema and digest. The source classifications remain operational fields and do not merge repository SJ into NO.

Pinned current Postnummerområder features for the exact SJ operator code set under the advertised CC BY 4.0 distribution, retaining code, feature identity, topology, source URL, provider attribution, capture and release/reference time, schema, source CRS, reviewed transform, coverage, exclusions and digest. A missing feature stays unresolved until a source-defined non-area reason is established.

artifact_partitions.rule: Four-digit assignment, postal place, municipality reference, 21/22 source classification, G/P/B/S category, effective time, terms and digest remain operator evidence separate from geometry.
Exact Postnummerområder features retain CC BY lineage and topology; missing, route, point, P.O.-box and special cases remain unresolved or explicit non-areas without invented surfaces.
Repository SJ identity, Svalbard, Jan Mayen, NO and each source's coverage/classification never infer or merge one another.
Addresses, buildings, units, occupants and ownership remain separately sourced and require explicit authoritative relationships.
Recipients, occupants, owners, rightsholders, contacts, title/value records, credentials, shipments and delivery instructions never enter public artifacts.
Non-production fixture metadata only; never promotion evidence.
